content.short: Glacis Labs builds ZeroDelta, a permissioned clearinghouse for moving RWAs across chains at size.
content.description: ZeroDelta, from Glacis Labs, matches institutional order flow so large amounts of stablecoins and tokenized assets can move between chains without slippage. Only KYB-verified institutions can quote or settle, and each issuer's rules, such as whitelists and transfer limits, are enforced on every transaction along with travel-rule data. It has settled more than $1 billion across 40+ chains.
content.meta: ZeroDelta by Glacis Labs moves stablecoins and RWAs across 40+ chains at size, with KYB-only access and built-in compliance.
